svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: YieldGPT architecture and trust boundaries
svg.text: YieldGPT: one question, every permission check, every trust boundary
Status as of 12 Oct 2026. Green boxes are permission checks against the native platform. Red is untrusted. Purple dashes are audit writes.
TRUSTED: YieldGPT server process (app.server:app)
Employee asks a question
1 AuditedDelivery (ASGI middleware)
Signed session token -> user. request_received logged. The whole response is held back until step 12.
2 Guard: prompt-injection check on the question
Injection attempt -> blocked answer, alert, nothing retrieved.
3 Planner
Which platforms and which time window. Routing only: it grants nothing.
4 CHECK A Index prefilter (acl_hint from last sync)
Drops candidates the user clearly cannot see. A hint can only remove, never allow.
No top-k cutoff before authorization. One authz_decision row per candidate (stage=prefilter).
5 CHECK B + C Live native check, before and after reading
B: connector.check(user) on the platform itself -> fetch the current version ->
C: check again, and the version must match. Linked documents (link hops) pass the same B + C gates.
Deny or unavailable at any point -> the document is dropped (stage=live / fetch rows).
6 Guard on content: redact secrets, quarantine poisoned passages
context_assembled logs exactly which document versions and passages go to the model.
8 Grounding (server side)
Unsupported claims are dropped; citations may only point at sources the model was given.
The server rebuilds the factual text and citations from authorized snapshots, not from model text.
9 CHECK D + E Release recheck for every cited source
Live check before and after a fresh read, just before the answer is released.
Access revoked meanwhile -> draft discarded (answer_discarded), rebuilt once without that source,
otherwise withheld. answer_returned records answer, citations, release outcome.
10 Audit chain (SQLite, append only)
Every row hashes the previous one. Each phase is written in one transaction (log_many); a failed
write fails the question. Question/answer/title text sealed with AES-GCM, redacted after retention.
Repeated attempts at one restricted doc raise probing_suspected.
11 Checkpoint: head (row id, hash) written to EVERY external anchor
Put-only credential. Any anchor write fails -> 503, response_withheld, no answer bytes leave.
Release rule: no protected checkpoint, no release.
12 Answer released to the employee
response_delivered logged. Cache-Control: no-store, private.
13 CHECK F Citation preview, on click
Per-user evidence cache (never shared across users) + live check + fresh read + fingerprint match
+ check again. Any failure -> 404 "Evidence is not available".
Compliance view (audit_policy)
Compliance: full stories. Platform admin: metadata only, pseudonymised actors. Everyone else: nothing.
Every audit read is itself audited. Standalone verifier: scripts/verify_audit.py (read-only key).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: native platforms
Each platform's own permission rules decide.
YieldGPT never copies ACLs into a decision.

g.text: issue security). Tested against a fake Atlassian site.
Multi-workspace OAuth, delegated reads, signed events.
Drive API v3 connector, asker's own token for checks.
Simulated by default; tested against a fake Drive API.

svg.text: Sync (polling + webhooks)
Keeps the index and acl_hint fresh. Webhooks verified
with each platform's own signature scheme. Freshness
helps recall only; checks B to F always go live.
check() + fetch
UNTRUSTED: the language model
7 LLM (stub today; Tencent Hunyuan
via OpenAI-compatible adapter: M2)
Sees only passages that passed checks A to C.
Holds no credentials and calls no tools.
Its output is treated as a proposal:
grounding (8) and the release recheck (9)
decide what reaches the user.
Prompt injection inside documents cannot
widen access: permissions are never asked of it.
INDEPENDENT: WORM checkpoint anchors
Outside the app's write authority.
Anchor 1: S3 Object Lock, COMPLIANCE
App credential: PutObject only. Verifier: read only.
Even storage root cannot delete a locked version.
Anchor 2: separate S3 Object Lock store
Own administrator and credentials. A forged anchor 1
disagrees with anchor 2 -> verify fails (equivocation).
live: 2 x MinIO
cloud (COS / S3): M3
Verifier checks genesis to latest anchor; reports
verified_through and the uncheckpointed tail separately.
Identity
Demo personas with seeded login and signed tokens
(demo mode only; not SSO). Each persona maps to its
own real account on each platform, so checks B to F
run as that person. Admin rights grant no source or
audit-content access.
simulated: needs SSO
Legend and evidence (12 Oct 2026)
Permission check on the native platform (A is a filter only; B to F are live)
Untrusted component: output is verified, never obeyed
Audit write (hash-chained, fail closed)
verified live
built, live run pending (owner)
simulated
Load test (fixture, stub model, MinIO anchors): 25 users x 5 min,
19,223 answers, 0 permission leaks, 0 audit gaps, 0 cross-user hits.
End to end p95 51 ms (fixture, stub model; model time excluded).
Audit search over 100,000 events: p95 950 ms (synthetic).
Reports: internal-brain/evaluation/reports/member3-*
